The e& Egypt Data Line is a dedicated internet SIM card for portable internet devices such
as MiFi and USB Modems, and is not intended for mobile phone use. It comes with 8 core
packages of varying sizes and multiple validities (1 month, 3 months, 6 months), and
features the "Double the Package" offer, which doubles the internet quota on the first
recharge only. Key Features of the Data Line
• The e& Egypt Data Line is exclusively dedicated to portable internet devices (MiFi)
and USB Modems, and does not work on mobile phones. • For the e& Egypt Data Line, the "Double the Package" offer doubles the internet
volume on the first recharge only for every new customer.

What is the Ahlan by the Second plan from e& Egypt? The Ahlan by the Second plan from e& Egypt is a prepaid tariff that bills by the second
instead of the minute. The rate varies by time: 3 milliemes per second for the night period
(from 12 midnight to 6 AM), and 4 milliemes per second for the daytime period (from 6 AM
to 12 midnight). What is the Daily Bundle in e& Egypt? The Daily Bundle in e& Egypt is one of two quick bundles: 55 Mixes for 1.5 EGP (code
*972#) or 120 Mixes for 2.5 EGP (code *973#). It is valid until midnight on the same day of
subscription. What are the Menu El Geneh bundles from e& Egypt? Menu El Geneh from e& Egypt consists of 3 micro-bundles under code *101#: Half-Pound
Menu (30 minutes to e& Egypt + 15 minutes to any network at 7 piastres/min), One-Pound
Menu (60/30 + 20 MB), and One-and-a-Half-Pound Menu (120/60 + 40 MB). What is the difference between Aqwa Card 19, 22.5, and 30 recharges from e& Egypt? The main differences between these Aqwa Card recharges from e& Egypt are: The 19 EGP
recharge offers 425 Mixes + 300 video/entertainment/social minutes + 400 Mix Hekaya Mini
recharge, valid for 6 days. The 22.5 EGP recharge offers 550 Mixes + 320 minutes + 525 Mix
Hekaya Mini recharge, valid for 7 days. The 30 EGP recharge offers 750 Mixes + 400
minutes + 700 Mix Hekaya Mini recharge, valid for 10 days. What is the difference between Aqwa Card 44 and 45 recharges from e& Egypt? The Aqwa Card 44 recharge from e& Egypt costs 44 EGP and gives the customer 1,100
Mixes with a 14-day validity, without video/entertainment minutes or a Hekaya Mini
recharge. Meanwhile, the Aqwa Card 45 recharge costs 45 EGP and gives only 700 Mixes,
but with a longer validity (28 days). Can a customer switch between different plans? Yes, an e& Egypt customer can switch between different plans (Ahlan Pay As You Go, Daily
Plans, Menu El Geneh) via the code *3333# or through the My e& Egypt app. Switching
between Daily Bundles in e& Egypt is free of charge. What is the code *811# in e& Egypt? The code *811# in e& Egypt is the unified subscription code for all Aqwa Card recharges
ranging from 5 EGP to 75 EGP. What is the code *3333# in e& Egypt? The code *3333# in e& Egypt is the general code for migrating between plans, inquiring
about offers, changing bundles, and checking balances.
